Q912.reason: She obtained the money by threat, but the owner was not actually put in fear and knew the bomb claim was false, so robbery is incomplete and false pretenses fails because he was not deceived.

Q925.reason: Betty's Greenacre interest ('ever consumed') can vest beyond lives in being, so it is void under the Rule Against Perpetuities and Friend keeps the fee, while Blackacre's condition is tied to Associate's lifetime, so it is valid and triggered for Betty.
